Subject: Routing certification request and DPA addendum questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving quickly on procurement but need to close two items before legal signs the SOW: a certified processor routing matrix showing which subprocessors touch EU/UK data, and a short attestation that Redwood can operate under the UK Addendum (UK IDTA) + SCCs for our account.

Can you: 
- Share a routing matrix (CSV is fine) that shows region by subprocessor, last updated date, and whether any onshore fallback exists for EU/UK workloads.
- Provide a short TIA/DTIA draft or a statement indicating where Redwood would host/route Medivault traffic by default and fallback behavior if an onshore-only requirement is enforced.
- Confirm expected timeline for DocuSign of the UK Addendum (we try to align signature with procurement).

We may need a limited escalation if your legal needs to redline language for residency or subprocessors. Please loop in the right folks.

Thanks,
Andrew

Andrew —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're able to provide the routing matrix and a draft TIA; attaching the initial artifacts for review. High level: by default Medivault EU/UK traffic will be routed to our eu-west-1 deployment (EU-only tenant), with optional dedicated capacity in customer VPCs for on-prem/residency requirements. Fallbacks: we can pin routes to EU-only GPU pools and disable cross-border caching if you require onshore-only processing.

Next steps from our side: 
- Kimberly will attach the processor routing CSV with last-updated timestamps.
- I'll attach a working TIA draft (redwood_tia_draft_v1.pdf) with suggested language for SCCs + UK Addendum compatibility.
- Marissa can lead legal redline coordination and provide a UK Addendum checklist and DocuSign template.

Timeline: 
- Routing CSV and TIA draft: end of day tomorrow (Thu).
- Legal-friendly UK Addendum + DocuSign package: by Friday EOD if no material changes; if legal requests substantive redlines we should expect 3–5 business days for finalization.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Marissa to confirm technical details and to own the DocuSign flow respectively. If it helps, we can prepare a single combined DocuSign (DPA + UK Addendum) for signature.

Best,
Hannah

Subject: Re: Routing certification request and DPA addendum questions

Andrew / Hannah,

Attaching the processor-routing-matrix.csv (snapshot taken 2027-12-02T07:00Z). Key notes included in the CSV and summarized below: 
- Primary routing for EU/UK data: eu-west-1 (AWS EU Ireland) – production tenant (default).
- Subprocessors that see plaintext model payloads are scoped in column 'access_type' (compute, cache, telemetry).
- Onshore fallback: we offer two approaches (1) EU-only dedicated capacity (reserved pools) or (2) private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for regulated workloads; both are available subject to capacity and signed contract.
- UK Addendum / IDTA: our standard UK Addendum is compatible with the SCCs mapping in section 2 of the TIA draft; for customers requiring additional contractual custody language we can circulate a short addendum (we have done this previously for healthcare customers).

Operational caveats: 
- Real-time streaming infra may still use cross-region control-plane endpoints for telemetry; data plane (model inputs/outputs) is pinned to eu-west-1 when EU-only is requested. We can add an audit log proof bundle scoped to your uptake.
- If Medivault requires soc2-like evidence (e.g., subprocessor SOC reports), we will stage the relevant package and request a signed NDA for the artifacts.

Attachment: processor-routing-matrix.csv (csv, 18KB)

Let me know if you want the CSV exported with additional columns (SCC mapping, contract clause pointers).

-Kim

Hannah / Kim / Marissa —

This is exactly what we needed, thank you. A few quick clarifications and asks before we hand off to procurement/legal: 
1) Could you confirm the exact clause references you rely on for UK Addendum compatibility (e.g., which SCCs mapping + IDTA sections we should expect to see)? If you can call out the clause numbers in the TIA draft, that will speed legal review.
2) We'd like the DocuSign to be a single envelope: Master DPA + UK Addendum (no separate signature flow). Can you confirm that Marissa can prepare that package and the expected signoff timeline?
3) Please include (or confirm availability of) an evidence bundle that contains the latest subprocessor attestations and a contact for SOC-report requests. We'll need that before vendor review meeting next Wednesday.

If you can get the updated TIA with clause refs and the DocuSign package by EOD Monday (2027-12-06), procurement will queue the PO and legal will move to signing next week.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a short call if anything is ambiguous.

Andrew
